en: Villeneuve: The Rise of a Legend
plotEn:
Villeneuve: The Rise of a Legend (French: Villeneuve : l'ascension d'une légende) is a Canadian biographical drama film, directed by Yan Lanouette Turgeon and released in 2026. A dramatization of the early life of Canadian racing driver Gilles Villeneuve, the film centres on his early efforts to establish his racing career.
